evidence: `npm run e2e:full` failed 1/10 tests; mobile accessibility flow stayed on `/login` after emulator email/password sign-in. Focused rerun exited 1 without useful output.
technicalCause: Sign-in helper assumes dashboard redirect after click; emulator auth/browser state can remain on login for mobile accessibility run.
userImpact: Full release confidence is reduced because a required full E2E command did not pass in this pass.
recommendedAction: Stabilize emulator auth setup and make sign-in helper assert visible auth errors before URL wait.

evidence: Java is OpenJDK 17.0.19 and emulator output warns firebase-tools will drop Java <21 support in firebase-tools@15.
technicalCause: E2E scripts pin firebase-tools@14.19.0 but general CLI is 15.22.2; host Java remains 17.
userImpact: Future emulator runs may fail after tool updates or when script pin is removed.
recommendedAction: Plan Java 21 runtime upgrade and keep firebase-tools pin intentional until migrated.

evidence: `npm ci` reports 16 total vulnerabilities including dev dependencies, while `npm audit --omit=dev` is clean.
technicalCause: Tooling/dev dependency graph contains moderate/high advisories.
userImpact: Production bundle audit is clean, but developer/CI tooling risk remains.
recommendedAction: Run scoped dev-dependency remediation phase; do not force-upgrade during audit.

evidence: React Doctor full scan is ok but reports 165 warnings across 57 files.
technicalCause: Large components, modal accessibility, array index keys, loading flag paths, and performance patterns are accumulated.
userImpact: Non-blocking today, but maintenance and accessibility debt can hide regressions.
recommendedAction: Create a focused React Doctor remediation phase after release-critical workflow issues.

evidence: Risk scan found admin/verify/apply/backfill scripts and direct Firestore write APIs in scripts and services.
technicalCause: Repository intentionally contains write-capable admin tooling.
userImpact: Safe with discipline, but dangerous if run against production without explicit approval.
recommendedAction: Keep scripts documented, gated, and excluded from broad daily QA; add dry-run manifests where missing.

evidence: Several prunable worktrees exist outside the active audit worktree.
userImpact: Low direct app risk, but increases operator confusion.
recommendedAction: Clean up prunable worktrees in a separate repo hygiene task only.

evidence: Preliminary scan finds legacy/phase/CPB references and unused exports from React Doctor/deslop.
technicalCause: Historical documents and compatibility helpers remain.
userImpact: Can confuse future audits if not separated from active product truth.
recommendedAction: Deep dead-code pass should confirm before deleting anything.
